quest.title: The Riddle of Sea and Sky
quest.description: Mualani successfully figures out the next destination based on the clues found in the valley, but it seems that new challenges await you there...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.num: Where the Springs Return: Act III
chapter.title: Journey to the Mysterious Island

talks.objective: Go to the location analyzed by Mualani

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay, this is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, where do we go next?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'm not completely sure yet. The map seems to indicate there's a mechanism here that crosses the water, but I still need to think about what these lines might be referring to...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I knew it! My theory was correct!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like he's got something to say again.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: If you have any suggestions, then please feel free to share.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I believe the mechanism that the lines are indicating is a Spiritway.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hmm, that is a possibility, but I don't remember anyone from the tribe setting up a Spiritdoor around here.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: According to my theory, it might not have been set up by humans. The dragons living in Natlan also used a similar device, long before the humans.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, the Spiritdoors your tribe uses may have been built imitating the dragon ones.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I remember now! Uncle Nuu did mention this possibility to me before...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: After learning about the legend, I realized that it was connected to my research, and so, I looked up a lot of related information.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Even though I haven't found an exact route to the mysterious island, I'm fairly certain I've deduced the geographical features of the island's surrounding areas.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Firstly, it's at an intersection between water and land, and secondly, there should be a high concentration of Phlogiston. My research indicates that the Spiritway was originally a natural phenomenon caused by the flow of Phlogiston.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Therefore, the area must contain many potential Spiritways, and the dragons who lived here in ancient times may have left behind some devices to control them.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ah... amazing! Now it all makes sense!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now everyone's contributing to the team!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Ahem... You flatter me. If my theory is correct, we should already be very close to the mysterious island. Once you've unlocked the mechanism, we'll be able to derive the island's location.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright, then let's start searching for the dragons' Spiritdoor!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: That's just a quick and easy name... I won't be able to include it in my thesis. Given the dragons used the device long before the humans, we should stick with a name that references no human concepts. Calling it a "Phlogiston Node" would be much more appropriate.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Uh, then let's start searching for the Phlogiston Node! Speaking of which, what does it look like, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken... look that way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it started glowing! This should be it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Looks like we can activate it once we get close enough. The light does remind me of a Spiritway.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But according to the map, there should be two more Phlogiston Nodes. Let's keep searching, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I'm so happy Viramdra was able to help the team.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... We finally found all of them!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Great work, everyone! Okay, now, first, we need to figure out how to control this thing. Hmm... Its qualities are very similar to that of a man-made device, but it doesn't seem as intuitive to me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: See, look at this... After activating a normal Spiritdoor, we could just go ahead and use it. But this one requires someone to stay and keep operating it here.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Also, according to the map, we need to activate the mechanism and switch between different Phlogiston Nodes to change the path of the Spiritway.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: If we don't operate the nodes properly, then the people on the Spiritway will come tumbling from the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that super dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: In theory, the process should be very safe, but only if the three Phlogiston Nodes are each being operated by someone.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Do you think you'd be able to operate it? I just tried, and it clearly requires more skill than a typical Spiritdoor.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Though I've never tried before, I've read a lot of information and theoretically should be able to properly control it. Let me give it a try...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: ...Huh? But in theory, this shouldn't happen.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: If Viramdra can't control it, then that also rules out me...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay... Well, how about you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #After all the adventures {NICKNAME}'s been on, handling something like this should be easy-peasy!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Alright, then it'll be up to {NICKNAME} to stay here and operate the Phlogiston Node. I'll go activate the mechanism.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'll let you know when we need to switch nodes. Just make sure you quickly head to the corresponding node and we should make it safely!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! But handling it this way sounds even more dangerous, Mualani.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it looks like the Spiritways are all above the water. I'm pretty good at swimming, so I'm not afraid if I end up falling in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it's so high, and you'll be falling so fast... If we don't manage to reach a node in time, or if we make a mistake, there's a lot that can happen...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Do you still remember the promise we made before we left, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Only those who can trust each other with their lives can reach the mysterious island. Since you two are willing to trust me, then naturally, I'm willing to trust you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You're better acquainted with her than I, so you should tell her to carefully reconsider her decision.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Viramdra is quite knowledgeable about Natlan's geography, so his ideas might also be worth considering. Perhaps you can give it some thought...

talks.objective: Use the Phlogiston Nodes to switch paths
Use the Phlogiston Nodes to switch paths

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I can't believe there was an error with my theory...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help with? I must thank you all for saving Viramdra earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whew... That was perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're amazing, Mualani! There were a couple moments Paimon thought it was over...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm confident I could do it all over again! Wait, why are the Phlogiston Nodes no longer lit?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, you're right...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: It appears the Phlogiston Nodes here need to automatically recharge. Once they're activated, they'll be unusable for some time.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: In that case, no matter what happens next, we have to seize our chance. Otherwise, who knows how long we'll have to wait for another shot.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Do you hear that...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The weather's getting gloomy... And a bunch of whirlpools just appeared in the water!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes, we need to get to higher ground and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You make your way up the hill nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hey, look over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there's a giant whirlpool over there!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yep, and that's our next stop...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...The info I deciphered from the map points to only one possibility... To reach the mysterious island, we must enter that massive whirlpool.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Forgive me for being frank, but as a guide of the People of the Springs, I'm sure you understand the danger of such a vortex even better than we do.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes, I know. But whether it's the information deciphered from the map, or the direction of the Spiritway that I observed in the air...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Everything points to the path ahead being hidden in that whirlpool!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: And what if you're wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Viramdra...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I'm not trying to be unreasonable. Unfortunately, I'm very knowledgeable in this area...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: The Spiritways must have affected the nearby bodies of water, and lowered the water level... That's why the whirlpools appeared.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: At this rate, some of the land that was once underwater will soon reappear at the surface and see the light of day again... Don't you think that sounds more like the definition of a mysterious island?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: So our goal should be the shallow waters. If we enter that vortex, the undercurrents will drag us to the bottomless abyss!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... He does seem to have a point.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I can't find any evidence to refute your claim for the moment, but I still trust my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Then it seems like it's time for our collaboration to come to an end.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't we all agree to trust each other!?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I have reached this conclusion based on my field of expertise, and I cannot deny it, even if you try to convince me otherwise. From now on, let us each choose our own way.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...No, I refuse!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Y—You...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Letting your clients separate themselves from the group in the middle of a journey will result in the worst luck possible! I will not agree to that.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Then we can implement the plan I proposed at the very beginning. You're not my guide, and as such, you don't have to take responsibility for me!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ugh, but you can't do that once you've traveled together as a group! If you were to leave now, we'll all be hit with bad luck. It's now beyond both of our control.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: How about this... You and Karya wait here. We'll go first and investigate the whirlpool.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I know you like to explain everything with theories and logic, so let me build my case first, and then I'll come back to convince you!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Well, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's get going!

talks.objective: Observe the changes in the water
Accompany Mualani to investigate the whirlpool

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the massive whirlpool is up ahead. Just the thought of going in there is making Paimon dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Do you also think that this is a reckless decision?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, well...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's okay, that's completely normal. Actually, I completely understand how Viramdra feels.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This is just how it is to be a guide. The tribe's experiences passed down from generation to generation are what give us the ability to guide our guests through hardships.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This gives us the power to decide which way we should go, but it also means that we must bear the consequences of our mistakes in judgment. Which could be quite dire this time...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Although I'm pretty convinced that all the leads we have collected are pointing us to the whirlpool, I still don't know what awaits us inside.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: If the scholars still choose to reject my plan, I won't have the confidence to ask them to only do as I say.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The same goes for the two of you. You are the commissioners, so if you think this is too risky, then it's perfectly reasonable if you want to end the trip here...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The good news is that I know the way back to the tribe very well!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani...

choices.text: We've already made a promise to each other.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! You've trusted us before, Mualani. Now it's our turn to trust you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, it's gonna take more than a whirlpool to scare the two of us! We all managed to make it back from the Night Kingdom. After an experience like that, what's so scary about being sucked into a whirlpool?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Aw, Paimon... C'mon, bring it in again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright... Let's investigate this whirlpool and see if we can gather any info to convince that scholar.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Matters of luck aside, he definitely knows a lot about geography. We'll need him on the team.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I know, it's just that we can't see much from here... I'll get closer to the water and have another look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a sec... Is it just Paimon, or does the whirlpool seem to be getting smaller?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: You're right... Maybe it's just like the Phlogiston Nodes and can only be active for a certain amount of time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That means we need to hurry!

response.speaker: Karya
response.text: Miss Guide, we have a problem!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Karya? What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Karya
response.text: I tried to persuade him, but Viramdra insisted on verifying his theory first.

response.speaker: Karya
response.text: He said that the water to the south was about to be shallow enough to wade through. But after he took a few steps, the water suddenly began to surge, and he was swept away.

response.speaker: Karya
response.text: I'm not much of a swimmer, so I came to call for help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why did this have to happen now... Can we still make it into the whirlpool?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: No need to hesitate. I'll get in the water and rescue him, just tell me which way he went, Karya!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: *coughing* *spluttering*

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whew... Karya came and found us just in time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, there they are!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Viramdra... thank goodness you're alright. Thank you so much, Miss Guide.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ugh, didn't I tell you to wait for me?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: *cough* Judging by the changes in the water's surface, the path to the mysterious island wouldn't be around for long! I didn't want to miss this opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: It's just... I didn't expect my calculations to be wrong. It seems you were right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, who knows if we can make it back in time now... Huh? The whirlpools have disappeared!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Seems we missed our chance...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Why would you give up on such an opportunity to come rescue me?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: How can you say that? It's already bad enough that you had to be left behind. Do you think I'd let anyone in my group drown?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't feel guilty, Karya. I think if I reactivate the nodes, that will cause the whirlpools to reappear.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The only problem is that we still don't know exactly when we'll be able to do that...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's already getting late now, and we've been on the move for the whole day. As your guide, I suggest we make camp first and have a good meal. We can talk about the other stuff tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, Paimon is feeling a little hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a miracle she hasn't mentioned food for so long...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon's stomach can be very sensible. It won't interrupt while everyone's busy solving puzzles.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We have plenty of tasty things to eat, let's just find a suitable spot to make camp. Hmm... I like that place right over there.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Mualani guides everyone to the best place to make camp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Is this the spot? Let Paimon and {NICKNAME} help set up the tent!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Go ahead! I'll take care of the fire. And here's a little camping tip, it's best to set the tent upwind from the campfire!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What do you think? This is a specialty dish I learned to make that's perfect for camping.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, it really hits the spot! You're a great cook, Mualani.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Karya helped out quite a bit, so she deserves some credit, too!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: No no, I'm just happy I was able to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What was that sound? Oh, it's scary to camp out at night...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Remember the record player I bought? Let me go turn it on.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Listen. Not bad, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so it really works? Paimon thought you were just playing it for good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: My parents told me that most of the valuable experience from our ancestors is hidden in various customs. It's always better to trust our traditions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, guess that makes sense...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: In a sense, this trip to the mysterious island is also a custom left behind by the first chief of the tribe. I wonder what kind of experience he's trying to share with us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of person was he like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, Paimon would like to know, too!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Even though I've heard my parents tell stories since I was little... I actually don't know too much about him.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's said that he was the first person to make a map of Natlan, and even the first person to become friends with the Koholasaurs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds pretty amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yeah, there isn't a place in Natlan that he didn't visit... even the most remote parts bear his footprints.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Even now, no one has even come close to his reputation and status as a guide. His trip to the mysterious island is the most legendary of all his accomplishments.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But oddly enough, after returning from the mysterious island, he laid aside his yearning for adventure and chose to settle down. That's how the tribe was founded.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It really makes me wonder what the journey meant to him.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ahem... A camping trip shouldn't be this stuffy and quiet! Everyone needs to help make it more lively!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: How about this... before we rest for the night, let's have a bonfire party!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: If we're going to go plunging into that whirlpool tomorrow, then wouldn't it be best to try to rest and conserve energy now?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Now's not the time to be a party pooper! You ought to agree to ideas from the one who rescued you today!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, she's right!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Alright... So what do the rules stipulate for a bonfire party?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Rules? A bonfire doesn't have any rules! Everyone just needs to have a good time. How about this, I'll ask everyone a question, and then we'll take turns saying what's on our mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, sounds fun enough!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, for the first question... what's the purpose of a journey?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we were just talking about this!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's hear everyone's ideas, and maybe we can figure out what the first chief was thinking back when he made the trip.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can go first! If you ask Paimon what the purpose of a journey is... it'd definitely be about treasure and all kinds of delicious food! And...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Most importantly, it's about making the trip together with your companions!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Yes, I can't agree more! Okay, next person... How about you, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The purpose of a journey...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You close your eyes and recall the moment you were separated from {M#her}{F#him}...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You remember the purpose of your journey has been to find {M#her}{F#him} all along... but you have yet to achieve this goal. You don't seem to see any other meaning to this long journey...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: However, you suddenly begin to recall the sound of the windmills creaking in Mondstadt, and the sight of the colorful night sky in Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Now, how to control the Phlogiston Nodes... Let me reflect on the information I read.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Help! *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That way? He's been pulled away by the current!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not here either... The current is too fast!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We found him!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We've found them all! Let's get everyone back together!
